dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Apr 12 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000q5ka](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000q5ka) Magnitude 6.2 earthquake at 72.502 depth occurred on Apr 12 2025 29km SE of Silur. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -4.7144 longitude 153.2351. It impacted 11060 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
